title: Game AI Unleashed: From Finite State Machines to Machine Learning
description: AI is used in games for NPC behaviour, procedural design, player experience, adaptive systems, and the craft behind believable play.
short_description: A practical guide to NPC behaviour, procedural systems, player experience, and the design choices hiding behind clever game AI.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in game development for game developers, designers, producers, and readers tracking interactive systems.
